description: Defines classes and interfaces for SDR Radio Unit control implementations, including gain, CFO, center frequency, and transmit time offset controllers, as well as a main SDR controller class.

classes.name: ru_gain_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Implementation of gain control for SDR radio units.

classes.name: ru_cfo_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Implementation of carrier frequency offset control for SDR radio units.

classes.name: ru_center_frequency_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Implementation of center frequency control for SDR radio units.

classes.name: ru_tx_time_offset_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Implementation of transmit time offset control for SDR radio units.

classes.name: ru_controller_sdr_impl
classes.description: Main SDR radio unit controller implementing various control interfaces.

methods.name: ru_gain_controller_sdr_impl
methods.description: Constructor for gain controller.

methods.name: set_tx_gain
methods.description: Sets transmit gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_rx_gain
methods.description: Sets receive gain for a specified port.

methods.name: ru_cfo_controller_sdr_impl
methods.description: Constructor for CFO controller.

methods.name: set_tx_cfo
methods.description: Sets transmit CFO for a sector.

methods.name: set_rx_cfo
methods.description: Sets receive CFO for a sector.

methods.name: ru_center_frequency_controller_sdr_impl
methods.description: Constructor for center frequency controller.

methods.name: set_tx_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets transmit center frequency for a sector.

methods.name: set_rx_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets receive center frequency for a sector.

methods.name: ru_tx_time_offset_controller_sdr_impl
methods.description: Constructor for transmit time offset controller.

methods.name: set_tx_time_offset
methods.description: Sets transmit time offset for a sector.

methods.name: ru_controller_sdr_impl
methods.description: Constructor for main SDR controller.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns reference to operation controller.

methods.name: get_gain_controller
methods.description: Returns pointer to gain controller.

methods.name: get_cfo_controller
methods.description: Returns pointer to CFO controller.

methods.name: get_center_frequency_controller
methods.description: Returns pointer to center frequency controller.

methods.name: get_tx_time_offset_controller
methods.description: Returns pointer to transmit time offset controller.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the SDR controller.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the SDR controller.

methods.name: set_radio
methods.description: Assigns a radio session to the controller.

methods.name: set_lower_phy_sectors
methods.description: Sets the lower physical sectors for the controller.
